questions.question:
16 is related to 24 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 22 is related to 33. To which of the following is 36 related, following the same logic?

(**NOTE : **Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding / subtracting / multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: 1st number × 1.5 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 16 : 24

⇒ 16 × 1.5 = 24.

For, 22 : 33

⇒ 22 × 1.5 = 33.

Similarly, for 36 ∶ ?

**⇒ 36 × 1.5 = 54.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

All houses are buildings.

Some houses are apartments.

**Conclusions :**

I. All buildings are houses.

II. Some buildings are apartments.

options.text: Both Conclusions I and II follow.
Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcf08f4d487c9c0271d5f51486d5d28ecb5cb34e3513574ffd35910e4108d32f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All buildings are houses → Does not follow (As all houses are buildings. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. Some buildings are apartments → Follow (As all houses are buildings and some houses are apartments. As whole houses comes in buildings and has some part common with apartments, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

_ L _ O P H _ N _ P H L N _ _ H L _ O _
questions.solution:
Given series: _ L _ O P H _ N _ P H L N _ _ H L _ O _ 

Option 1) HNOLOPPN → __H__ L __N__ O P H __O__ N __L__ P H L N __O__ __P__ H L __P__ O __N__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) NHLOPONP → __N__ L __H__ O P H __L__ N __O__ P H L N __P__ __O__ H L __N__ O __P__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) NHOLOPPN → __N__ L __H__ O P H __O__ N __L__ P H L N __O__ __P__ H L __P__ O __N__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) HNLOOPNP → __**H**__ L __**N**__ O P H __**L**__ N __**O**__ P H L N __**O**__ __**P**__ H L __**N**__ O __**P**__ → (It follows the pattern of: HLNOP - HLNOP - HLNOP - HLNOP)

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must NOT be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants / vowels in the word)

Hot : Summer :: Cold : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic:** Seasons associated with temperatures**.

Here,

Hot : Summer → **Summer** is a season associated with hot** temperatures**.

Similarly,

Cold : Winter → **Winter **is a season associated with cold temperatures.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
